answer.explanation: InvoiceController in the presentation layer imports and is constructor-injected with InvoiceRepository from the persistence layer (line 2). Its cancel method calls repo.markCancelled directly, so it skips the business layer. FF-S03 flags this because presentation should depend only on business, and business on persistence. The README states the same rule: a controller never imports a repository, and every write goes through InvoiceService. The issue method follows the rule by calling InvoiceService. The cancel write path does not. Nothing in the docs grants an exception.
